needs_human.note: Since c2d901997, a selected file that the filter comes to hide while the text stays the same stays selected while hidden. Examples are an inline rename to a non-matching name, or a websocket update after which the reloaded rows no longer match it. A later bulk action (trash, move, copy) would include it, and SelectionBar can show a count above totalCount. The test file's UNSPEC comment says 'a file the filter comes to hide leaves the selection'; only text-driven hiding does now. Relative to origin/develop this is not a regression, because the base never pruned.; If the filter text changes after a reload has brought back only page 1, matching selected files from later pages are dropped because they are not loaded. With no filter text change, they survive. Whether a selection should survive for files that are not loaded is not specified.; Pre-existing, unchanged: FolderBrowser toolbar `fileIds` and handlePlayAll / hasPlayableFiles (FolderBrowser.tsx:609-648) still read the unfiltered `files`.
